protocol.scope: Technical evaluation of the complete M2-M7 platform and its CLI, Python and Workbench research access paths for a platform-and-methods paper.

amendment.predecessor_location: External frozen Paper 1 material; absent from and not modified by this software-repository amendment.
amendment.reason: Paper 1 is repositioned from an M1/M2-focused study to a platform-and-methods paper covering the implemented M2-M7 multiscale stack and all three research access paths.
change_history: Scope extended from body/kernel emphasis to the integrated M2-M7 platform.
FP9 explicitly classified as software and integration evidence, not biological or clinical feasibility evidence.
Evidence/provenance continuity, multiscale composition, bounded observation, M7 resources and access-path integrity added as technical evaluation axes.
The frozen RQ4 body-transport campaign is retained unchanged and incorporated as experiment P1-E1.

evaluation_questions.question: Can identical versioned inputs and named random streams be executed reproducibly on supported platforms and through supported access paths?
evaluation_questions.claim_boundary: Technical reproducibility only; no platform-independent wall-time equivalence or scientific validity follows.

evaluation_questions.question: Does composition of replaceable body, lung, capillary, cell and communication models preserve declared conservation and causal identities?
evaluation_questions.claim_boundary: Implemented contracts and reference scenarios only; arbitrary third-party model compatibility is not claimed.

evaluation_questions.question: Can every reported result be traced to versioned inputs, evidence roles, validity limits, hashes and separated calibration/validation sources?
evaluation_questions.claim_boundary: Traceability completeness does not upgrade weak evidence into biological or clinical validity.

evaluation_questions.question: How do bounded observation and the CLI, Python and Workbench access paths affect runtime, memory, retained volume and result integrity?
evaluation_questions.claim_boundary: Descriptive measurements on recorded hardware; not a universal scalability or usability claim.

conditions.revision: The clean Git commit containing this locked protocol, recorded verbatim in run metadata.
supported_measurement_platforms: Linux x86-64 with GCC Release when independently executed
conditions.primary_machine: One frozen local machine label recorded before execution; no pooling across machines.
conditions.environment: Close discretionary heavy applications where practical; do not suppress OS services; record rather than conceal deviations.
conditions.precision: Retain raw tool precision; do not round raw observations. Rounding is permitted only in derived human-readable summaries.

experiments.purpose: Execute the pre-existing frozen Paper 1 RQ4 campaign and test whether O0-O3 bounded observation changes authoritative transport state.

seeds.random_stream_mapping: CompartmentTransport uses its declared named stream; observation consumes no model RNG draws.

experiments.order: Within each block independently randomize ten mandatory policy/population conditions plus the long-duration anchor using the frozen ordering seed; preserve the generated execution plan.

tolerances.timing_and_memory: descriptive; median, inclusive quartiles, IQR and range
tolerances.conditional_population_gate: run only if frozen O0 100000 medians satisfy both plan thresholds

positive_controls: Frozen O3 pilot limits have headroom and match the plan.
O0 6,359-entity two-hour anchor reproduces without retained detail.
negative_controls: Campaign runner rejects a dirty tree, non-Release driver, placeholder machine label, altered pilot limits and schema-invalid inputs.

experiments.purpose: Characterize a deliberately small complete M7 execution for resources, deterministic replay, artifact identity, causal identity and one controlled collector-count variation.
models: all thirteen artifact references in fp9-lung-level-a-v1

seeds.random_stream_mapping: Scenario-owned names recorded by result provenance; identical seeds are used to isolate collector-count variation.

experiments.order: Alternate baseline and variation after one unreported warm-up of each: baseline-1, variation-1, baseline-2, variation-2, baseline-3, variation-3.
metrics: recursive run-directory bytes and file count

tolerances.runtime_memory_and_volume: descriptive; report every replicate and median/range
tolerances.between_condition: differences allowed only where collector count causally affects declared results

positive_controls: Every completed result validates through the authoritative result reader.
negative_controls: Schema-invalid scenario is rejected before run.
A tampered result copy is rejected by provenance/hash integrity inspection and is never counted as a measured run.

experiments.purpose: Verify that CLI, Python and Workbench delegate to the same authoritative validators/readers and do not transform scientific result values.

seeds.mapping: Access paths receive the same versioned scenario; no access layer owns a scientific RNG.

experiments.order: Create the authoritative result through the CLI, then inspect through CLI summary, Python load_result and Workbench audit/dashboard projections; repeat readers without rerunning physics.

tolerances.presentation_only_fields: may differ and must be listed

positive_controls: Python load_result accepts and projects the authoritative result.
Workbench audit reports mehlissa.load_result and the identical source hash.
negative_controls: Python rejects a campaign document as a scenario result.
Workbench and Python reject missing, malformed or hash-tampered authoritative artifacts.

handling_rules.partial_run: Retain its ledger entry, stdout, stderr, timestamps and any created files; exclude it from completed-run summaries but report it in attempt counts.
handling_rules.failed_run: Never replace or silently rerun in place. Retain the failure and diagnostic; a retry receives a new attempt ID and declared reason.
handling_rules.resource_limited_run: Record timeout or memory limit, last observed resource values and retained artifacts. Do not extrapolate missing measurements.
handling_rules.missing_run: Represent explicitly as missing with reason; do not impute.
handling_rules.unexpected_results: Retain and report without changing thresholds or silently redefining the question.
handling_rules.test_counts: Useful verification metadata but never a scientific result by themselves.
handling_rules.clinical_interpretation: Forbidden. FP9 is a software/integration demonstrator.

archive_layout.protocol: protocol/ with this JSON, schema, human guide and SHA-256 manifest
archive_layout.raw: measurements/<experiment-id>/raw/<attempt-id>/ with immutable stdout, stderr and generated artifacts
archive_layout.analysis: measurements/<experiment-id>/analysis/ with machine-readable summaries and the exact analysis scripts
archive_layout.hashes: SHA256SUMS.json containing normalized repository-relative paths, byte counts and SHA-256
archive_layout.logs: tests/ and ci/ for commands, exit status, timestamps and URLs
archive_layout.policy: No tmp/, local build tree or uncurated benchmark scratch directory is committed.
